title: In This Crisis, the Best Investors Can Expect From the Fed Is Nothing
snippet: # The Best We Should Hope For From the Fed: Nothing - The New York Times. A rate cut in the next few months could signal major problems in the economy. Powell, the Fed chair, said on Wednesday, when discussing the potential impact of the war with Iran.Credit...Caroline Gutman for The New York Times.
